Course Introduction
text:
Working definition of government
Government is the organization whose use of organized coercive force is widely treated as legitimate.

title:
USGOVT101: U.S. Constitution and Politics
Course Introduction
text:
Why limit government

Government limits criminal and foreign violence — and is itself coercive force.
Humans are not omniscient. Trade-offs and unintended consequences are normal.
Counter-majoritarian rules exist so losers of elections still have rights and a chance to win next time.
